question: On a browser task long enough for the context to pass the cut's trigger (two hundred product pages, about five hundred tool calls), what does a session cost with no proxy and with the cut and its long-turn rule, and does each still pass?
rule: One task, review-audit-200: browser-read's task at five times the length, written 2026-11-16 after its sessions ended at 100k of context, under the 140k trigger. Same disallowed tools. The page rule's arm is left out: it added 27% on browser-read. Chosen before any session of it ran.
